description: This file defines Express routes for managing lessons in a web application, including endpoints for listing lessons, retrieving a specific lesson, updating progress, and admin operations such as creating, updating, and deleting lessons.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Defines GET endpoints for listing lessons and retrieving a lesson by ID.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Defines POST endpoint for updating lesson progress and creating lessons (admin).

methods.name: router.put
methods.description: Defines PUT endpoint for updating a lesson by ID (admin).

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Defines DELETE endpoint for deleting a lesson by ID (admin).
